title: Localization: Automatic Grammar Agreement
hints: Convert to a plain string with `String(attributed.characters)`.
jsBridge: `^[\(n) item](inflect: true)` makes Foundation pick the right grammatical form for the language. The web equivalent is `Intl.PluralRules` plus hand-written messages; Apple's version inflects the noun for you.

compass.q: `Intl.PluralRules` tells you "one"/"other", and you still write both strings. What does Swift's automatic grammar agreement add?
Which languages support automatic inflection? What happens in unsupported ones?
